title: Multi Hook Wall Mount Rack 6-Hook Solid Brass 15.5-Inch | Brass Multi Hooks | Allied Brass
description:
Clear clutter fast in your bathroom with a wall-mounted multi hook that keeps robes, towels, belts, and jackets easy to grab. This wall mount multi hook rack (also called a multi-hook hanger or wall hook rack) adds organized hanging space while keeping a clean, finished look.

Highlights:
- Store more in less space: 6-position multi hook design keeps everyday items separated and accessible
- Clean installation: concealed screw mounting hardware for a tidy, built-in appearance
- Enduring build: solid brass construction / brass construction for lasting use
- Coordinated look: part of the Brass Multi Hooks collection for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Finish flexibility: available in multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: multi hook / wall hook rack / multi-hook hanger
- Mounting: wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging; concealed screw mounting hardware included
- Material: solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 x 3.2 x 4 inches
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 12 x 6 x 4 inches
- Shipping weight: 3 lbs
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
